name: apikuoshi
description: APIKuoshi — one anime REST API: search, browse, metadata and playback through a single normalized surface, with the one-call /api/chain streaming pipeline. v2.7.1: /api/anime/episodes gets a bulk Kitsu episode fetch (one bounded-parallel paginated walk replaces the per-episode HTTP N+1 that made One Piece time out), per-episode TMDB is gated by EPISODE_TMDB_THRESHOLD (default 50, ?withThumbs=1 to force), and ?page=&perPage= pagination with a ready-to-use pagination.next URL.
